messages:
kendra: Quick heads-up — prepping offline bundle v1.4.8 for private VPC customers, targeting tonight's 22:00 UTC delivery window. Need packaging+transport checklist and signer/KMS status.

mike: ETA on the shrinkwrap and delta-chunking?

kendra: Shrinkwrap done, delta chunks building now. Final zip should be ready by 19:30 UTC for integ smoke.

oli: KMS rotation scheduled 19:45 UTC (key: rw-key-2026). If rotation overlaps signing we should fallback to legacy signer for the transport mirrors.

jess: Can we avoid fallback? We can queue signing pre-rotation if build finishes before 19:40. Otherwise fallback plan required.

sam: Packaging bot can hold artifacts in /staging/offline/v1.4.8/ready. I'll add a lock if we start signing.

packaging-bot: artifact uploaded: /staging/offline/v1.4.8/bundle.zip (sha256: a3f9...e21). awaiting cosign step.

kendra: Perfect. @oli please confirm KMS rotation contingency: if rotation hasn't completed by 20:05 UTC we switch to cosign using legacy key and mark manifest as pinned in deploybot.

oli: Confirmed. contingency: legacy-cosign until 22:30, then require re-sign with new KMS in next maintenance window. Documented in release notes.

mike: What are the rollback triggers? If a canary node fails to unpack or install, do we pin back to v1.4.7 or abort whole rollout?

jess: Ops praas suggested: fail-on-canary > abort canary and mark rollout paused; only auto-rollback to v1.4.7 on checksum mismatch during install. For other errors, manual rollback after triage.

kendra: Solid. We'll include explicit rollback criteria in the release metadata. Quick checklist: cosign done, manifest pinned, deploybot canary = 3 nodes, transport TTL 2h, ops oncall alerted. Anything else?

sam: Add offline manifest TTL and chunk index mapping to the release notes (so ops can replay chunk fetches).

packaging-bot: cosign completed by legacy key (key-id: legacy-2024). manifest pinned as offline/v1.4.8/manifest.json.

deploy-bot: deploy job queued: private/vpc/offline/v1.4.8 - canary=3 - window=2026-03-21T22:00Z. Watch at: https://deploy.redwood.com/jobs/8791 :rocket:

mike: I'll watch the first canary. Jess, Oli — if signer rotation hits, will Ops need to rotate mirroring endpoints?

oli: No, mirroring endpoints fine. Only signature validation changes; old signatures accepted for this release due to pinned manifest.

jess: Reminder: release notes snippet for customers about KMS rotation and signature TTL. Kendra can you add the blurb?

kendra: Will do. Draft: "This release is delivered with a pinned manifest for compatibility during our scheduled KMS rotation. Signatures may be transitioned post-delivery; clients should validate by manifest SHA."

sam: preflight command I'm running now: 
```
./scripts/offline_preflight.sh --bundle /staging/offline/v1.4.8/bundle.zip --check-sha
```
All green on checksum and chunk indexes.

packaging-bot: checksum: OK. chunk_count: 24. recommended batch size: 6.

deploy-bot: canary started on host worker-ops-24. logs: https://logs.redwood.com/8791/worker-24

mike: worker-24 unpack failed with "tar: unexpected EOF" — retrying fetch.

jess: If retry fails, abort canary and mark rollout paused. Sounds like network hiccup.

deploy-bot: worker-24 fetch retry 1: success. unpack OK. healthcheck passed.

kendra: Good. keep eyes on any checksum mismatch alerts. If we see mismatch, roll back to v1.4.7 and open a follow-up incident.

mike: Noted. I'll keep channel updated. :eyes: 

kendra: Thanks all — I'll post release notes and update changelog. :shipit:
